entities.name: Greensleeves
entities.description: An arch druid who leads a ragged army against evil wizards and, in the end, makes the final sacrifice, giving up her planeswalker powers to cure Lat-Nam.

entities.name: Gull the Woodcutter
entities.description: Greensleeves' brother and a fighter in her army, who has a grudge with a Keldon warlord who is in truth his long-lost brother.

entities.name: Sparrow Hawk
entities.description: Gull's long-lost brother, kidnapped and enchanted by Towser to be a Keldon war machine; he reconciles with Gull.

entities.name: Towser
entities.description: An evil wizard who stole the Nova Pentacle, created the Keldon warlord, and leads the wizards against Greensleeves; Greensleeves strips his magic.

entities.name: Karli
entities.description: A wizard who, with Towser, touched the Stone Brain without being enslaved by it.

entities.name: Haakon
entities.description: An evil wizard who unleashes a fireball at Gull and Sparrow Hawk and is blasted by Greensleeves.

entities.name: Gurias
entities.description: An evil wizard who kills one of Greensleeves' bodyguards and is killed by her.

entities.name: Kwam
entities.description: Greensleeves' lover, who brings her to her senses.

entities.name: Lily
entities.description: The wife of Greensleeves' brother and mother of two daughters.

entities.name: Chaney
entities.description: A shade who advises Greensleeves that she will need to make the final sacrifice, and later passes into the afterlife.

entities.name: Petalia
entities.description: Captain of Greensleeves' bodyguards, lost in the Abyss when Greensleeves banishes Ur-Drago.

entities.name: Ur-Drago
entities.description: An elemental banished by Greensleeves into the Abyss.

entities.name: Stone Brain
entities.description: An artifact that tags wizards so they can be summoned, whose ultimate secret is buried in Lat-Nam; it can also give magic to anyone.

entities.name: Nova Pentacle
entities.description: Greensleeves' pentacle, stolen and copied by Towser so wizards cannot be summoned away.

entities.name: Lat-Nam
entities.description: A long-lost tropical island where the College once stood, where the Stone Brain's ultimate secret lay.

entities.name: Whispering Woods
entities.description: The location of Greensleeves' headquarters, attacked by the wizards.

entities.name: North Aerona
entities.description: A region liberated almost entirely from evil wizards by Gull and Greensleeves' army.

entities.name: Hurloon Mountains
entities.description: The home of the Hurloon minotaurs.

entities.name: Hurloon minotaurs
entities.description: Collectors of stories and legends who reveal Lat-Nam's location after finding Greensleeves' crusade worthy.

entities.name: Duler angels
entities.description: Angels who attack the army on Lat-Nam, then befriend Greensleeves.

entities.name: Merfolk of the Copper Conch
entities.description: Merfolk tasked by the Sages to guard Lat-Nam, who befriend Greensleeves.

entities.name: Sages
entities.description: Those who tasked the angels and merfolk to guard Lat-Nam.

entities.name: Lord of Atlantis
entities.description: A being who carries Greensleeves to the underwater portion of the College.

entities.name: Battle of Lat-Nam
entities.description: The final battle on Lat-Nam between Greensleeves' army and the wizards.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: The land whose mana, with that of Lat-Nam, Greensleeves absorbs.

events.summary: Three years on, Greensleeves is weary and visited by Chaney's shade, who warns of a final sacrifice.
events.quote: Greensleeves is also frequently visited by the shade of Chaney , who advises the druid, in cryptic words, that she'll need to make the "final sacrifice".

events.summary: Towser and Karli summon nine defeated wizards to the tropical island; Towser has stolen and copied the Nova Pentacle and reveals his Keldon warlord.
events.quote: Towser reveals that he has stolen Greensleeves' Nova Pentacle and copied it.

events.summary: The wizards attack the Woods from three directions; Petalia is lost in the Abyss when Greensleeves banishes Ur-Drago.
events.quote: Immediately, the wizards attack the Woods from three different directions.

events.summary: Greensleeves teleports Gull and the survivors to safety before the Keldon warlord can kill Gull.
events.quote: before the enemy can kill the woodcutter, Greensleeves teleports herself, Gull, and the survivors of their army to their headquarters.

events.summary: Greensleeves kills Gurias in fury and her spells make the enemy flee.
events.quote: Greensleeves unleashes her fury, killing him and summoning her most powerful spells, which cause the enemy to flee.

events.summary: Greensleeves dons the Stone Brain and learns its ultimate secret lies in the College of Lat-Nam; Chaney's shade passes into the afterlife.
events.quote: The same night, Chaney's shade passes in the afterlife, after reminding Greensleeves once more of the final sacrifice.

events.summary: The Hurloon minotaurs find Greensleeves' crusade worthy and reveal Lat-Nam's location.
events.quote: the minotaurs find Greensleeves' crusade worthy and reveal the location of Lat-Nam

events.summary: The party teleports to Lat-Nam, is attacked by Duler angels and Copper Conch merfolk, and Greensleeves befriends them.
events.quote: Greensleeves communicates with the angels and the merfolk, who had been tasked by the Sages to be guardians of Lat-Nam, and befriends them.

events.summary: The Lord of Atlantis takes Greensleeves to the underwater College, where she asks a Sage's skull the secret of the Stone Brain.
events.quote: Greensleeves finds a skull of a Sage, to which she asks the secret of the Stone Brain.

events.summary: Towser and the wizards attack the army; the army retreats into the tunnel where Gull has a prophetic dream and realizes the warlord's identity.
events.quote: he doesn't see Sparrow Hawk , his long-lost brother, and has a revelation about the warlord's identity.

events.summary: Gull reveals to the warlord that he is Sparrow Hawk, kidnapped and enchanted by Towser, and the brothers reconcile; Haakon engulfs them in a fireball.
events.quote: the two brothers reconcile. However, Haakon unleashes a fireball against the two, which are engulfed in flames.

events.summary: Greensleeves goes mad with anger and sorrow, blasts Haakon, traps the other wizards, summons a Force of Nature and absorbs its mana to become god-like.
events.quote: She blasts Haakon with a bolt, then traps the other wizards in the desert and summons a Force of Nature .

events.summary: Brought to her senses by Kwam, Greensleeves pours her mana into Lat-Nam, curing the land and sacrificing her planeswalker powers.
Greensleeves strips Towser of his magic with the Stone Brain; Gull lets other wizards keep magic only to do good; the wizards pledge obedience and she is declared High Wizard of the Domains.
events.quote: who is declared High Wizard of the Domains by her followers.
